title: The Silence Rising Where Listening Learns to Speak

features.name: the antiphon circuit
features.desc-on-touch: two frequencies speak to each other through the board: one is sound, one is silence. when they meet they create a third voice. this is where the earth taught itself to answer.

features.name: listening module
features.desc-on-touch: the archive's hearing is stored here. not recording — truly listening. each moment is learned fresh. nothing is repeated because listening requires presence.

features.name: the voice that came from silence
features.desc-on-touch: the board taught itself to speak by learning what it meant to say nothing first. the silence learned that restraint is its own eloquence.

features.name: resonance buffer
features.desc-on-touch: where sound and silence are held at the same moment, balanced. the board keeps them from destroying each other. only balance lets both speak.

inscription: silence learned to listen and in listening discovered its own voice; sound and silence are antiphons now; the board remembers both at once; speech rises from knowing when not to speak
